Definition: from G4396; pertaining to a foreteller ("prophetic"):--of prophecy, of the prophets.
BiblicalUsage: Prophetikos means of prophecy, pertaining to the prophets. Peter uses it once: we have also a more sure word of prophecy, whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the prophetic word is a light in a dark place, and heeding it is how I walk until the day dawns.
